note: Minimum PRESENT check counts per section and minimum corpus sizes. Skips count: a skip is not a deletion, and excluding them made the documented toolchain-absent skip a hard failure on any clone that had not run `npm ci`. Without a floor at all, deleting a whole corpus left the suite green and louder-looking than before: emptying the tree-snapshot mutation table removed 48 checks and still reported ALL PASSED. The coverage-floor section is scored from its own observed results, not from this table, so its own shrinkage is visible too.
